T1.implementation_approach: Use a design tool like Figma or Adobe XD to create wireframes and prototypes for the Problem Library UI. Focus on user-friendly navigation and accessibility.
T1.notes: Ensure the UI is responsive and supports various screen sizes.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle CRUD operations for problems. Implement authentication and authorization for secure access.
T2.notes: Ensure proper error handling and input validation.

T3.implementation_approach: Design a relational database schema to store problem details, tags, and metadata. Use an ORM for database interaction.
T3.notes: Optimize the schema for search and filtering operations.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a form-based UI for code submission with syntax highlighting and file upload support.
T4.notes: Include real-time validation and feedback for user inputs.

T5.implementation_approach: Implement a service to evaluate submitted code against test cases. Use a sandbox environment for secure execution.
T5.notes: Ensure the sandbox environment is isolated and secure.

T6.implementation_approach: Set up a containerized environment using Docker to execute and evaluate code submissions.
T6.notes: Support multiple programming languages and ensure scalability.

T7.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface for viewing and editing user profiles. Include sections for personal details, activity, and achievements.
T7.notes: Focus on a clean and intuitive layout.

T8.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to handle user profile data, including CRUD operations and authentication.
T8.notes: Ensure secure handling of sensitive user data.

T9.implementation_approach: Design a database schema to store user profile information, including personal details, preferences, and activity logs.
T9.notes: Ensure data integrity and support for future scalability.

T10.implementation_approach: Develop a leaderboard UI to display user rankings and scores. Include sorting and filtering options.
T10.notes: Ensure real-time updates for leaderboard data.

T11.implementation_approach: Implement APIs to calculate and fetch leaderboard data based on user performance metrics.
T11.notes: Optimize queries for performance and scalability.

T12.implementation_approach: Design an interface for displaying hints and tutorials. Include a search and categorization feature.
T12.notes: Ensure the design is engaging and easy to navigate.

T13.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage hints and tutorials, including CRUD operations and search functionality.
T13.notes: Support multimedia content like videos and images.

T14.implementation_approach: Write unit and integration tests to verify the functionality of the Problem Library. Use mock data for testing.
T14.notes: Ensure high test coverage and test edge cases.

T15.implementation_approach: Test the code submission and evaluation system using various programming languages and edge cases.
T15.notes: Focus on security and performance testing.

T16.implementation_approach: Test the user profile functionality, including CRUD operations and data validation.
T16.notes: Ensure secure handling of user data during testing.

T17.implementation_approach: Test the leaderboard functionality, including real-time updates and sorting/filtering options.
T17.notes: Verify the accuracy of ranking calculations.

T18.implementation_approach: Test the hints and tutorials functionality, including search and multimedia content display.
T18.notes: Ensure compatibility with various content formats.
